title: Generation of functional heart organoids from mouse embryonic stem cells.
protocol: Coat 12-well plates with 1 ml of 0.2% gelatin solution per well.
Remove 0.2% gelatin solution by aspirating.
Seed mitomycin treated mouse embryonic fibroblast (MEF) feeder cells at a density of 100,000 cells per well in 1 ml of MEF medium.
Incubate seeded cells at 37℃ and 5% CO2 for 1 day.
Wash MEF plates with 1 ml of PBS (-).
Remove PBS (-) from the plates.
Seed murine ESCs at a density of 100,000 cells per well in 1 ml of KSR based ESC medium supplemented with CHIR99021 (3mM), PD0325901 (1mM), and LIF (1000 Unit/ml).
Incubate seeded ESCs at 37℃ and 5% CO2.
Change ES medium every day.
After 2 days, aspirate culture medium from the wells.
Wash cells with 1 ml of PBS (-).
Add 0.4 ml of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA solution to each well.
Incubate at 37℃ for 3 minutes.
Add 1 ml of 10% FBS-DMEM medium and pipette cells with a 1000 μl tip.
Count the number of cells using a hemacytometer.
Pool the cells into a 15 ml tube and centrifuge at 1,500 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the medium from the cell pellet.
Resuspend cells in ES medium supplemented with CHIR99021 (3mM), PD0325901 (1mM), and LIF (1000 Unit/ml).
Seed murine ESCs at a density of 100,000 cells per well on MEF plates.
Incubate the seeded ESCs at 37℃ and 5% CO2.
Prepare 6-well culture plates coated with 0.2% gelatin solution, before trypsinization of ESCs.
Aspirate culture medium from 2 days cultured ESCs and wash the cells with 1 ml of PBS (-).
Add 0.2 ml of 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA solution and incubate at 37°C for 2-3 minutes.
Add 1 ml of 10% FBS-DMEM medium and pipette cells with 1000 μl tip.
Pool the cells and transfer the cells into 6-well plates coated with 0.2% gelatin and incubated at 37°C for 45 minutes to remove feeder cells.
Collect floating ESCs gently without contamination of feeder cells and count the number of cells by using hemacytometer.
Centrifuge at 1,000 rpm for 5 minutes.
Aspirate medium and resuspend the cells with warm FBS-supplemented ES medium without LIF (FBS ES medium).
Seed 1,000-5,000 ESCs in 200 μl of FBS ES medium onto each well of a U-bottomed 96-well plate by using 8-channel pipettor.
Incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator for 4 days without changing medium. The cells form aggregate spheres on the next day of seeding.
Thaw 2 mg/ml of LN/ET complex on ice before coating plates.
Add 30 μl of LN/ET complex into a well of 8-well chamber slides.
Incubate 8-well chamber slides at room temperature for 2 hours.
Warm the heart organoid medium and FGF4.
Mix the heart organoid medium with FGF4 (30-60 ng/ml).
Add 200 μl of the medium to each well of LN/ET gel-coated 8-well chamber slides.
Transfer an EB cultured for 4 days into a well containing the medium, using a 200 μl pipette tip.
Maintain cultures in a 5% CO2 incubator at 37°C.
Replace the medium on day 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 14, and 15.
From day 9, supplement FGF4-heart organoid medium with BMP4 (50 ng/ml), BIO (2.5 μM), and LIF (1,000 units/ml).
Carefully transfer heart organoids into iMatrix-411-coated chamber slides in 200 μl of heart organoid medium for long-term culture.
Observe the morphogenesis of heart organoids under a microscope.
Collect heart organoids over 9 days of culture after chamber formation using wide bore tips and/or fine dissection forceps under a stereomicroscope.
